# Feature: Meshy avatar auto-rig after generate

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
After Meshy text-/image-to-3D materializes a static GLB, run Meshy Auto-Rig (full-rig) before success so the Character Editor loads a skeletoned model. `#6` remain SoT for capabilities — provider success never invents ready/limited flags.

## Preconditions
- Meshy BYOK configured; Character Editor Meshy source.
- Existing generate job reaches provider SUCCEEDED with a GLB URL (or remeshed GLB).
- Edge `character-avatar-meshy` poll path owns materialize.

## Happy Path
- [ ] After mesh ready, job stays in `rigging` while Meshy Auto-Rig runs (progress advances, overlay stays busy).
- [ ] On Auto-Rig SUCCEEDED, Edge downloads rigged GLB (or VRM if provided), stores under owner `character-avatars`, returns `modelUrl` with `rig_analysis_status: pending`.
- [ ] Client loads model; `#6` analyzeAvatarRigFromObject3D runs — typically `rigged`/`humanoid` instead of static-only when bones map.
- [ ] Confirm modal / credits estimate can mention Auto-Rig cost delta if already estimated in domain helper (or reuse existing estimate without inventing new paid UI if unknown).

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Auto-Rig PENDING/IN_PROGRESS → poll returns `rigging` + remesh/rig task id persisted; no double-create (idempotent task id on job row).
- [ ] Auto-Rig FAILED → job `failed` with DE error; static mesh is not falsely marked ready.
- [ ] Missing API key mid-rig → `provider_unavailable`.
- [ ] Oversized GLB still remeshes before Auto-Rig when needed (existing remesh path).
- [ ] Capabilities stay `pending` on poll success (`assertNoCapabilityFromProviderStatus`).

## Regression
- [ ] Text + image generate still work; remesh path still works.
- [ ] Kong URL rewrite for browser modelUrl still applied.
- [ ] `avatar-meshy-generation-check` PASS; rigging-provider contract mocks unchanged in meaning.

## Assumptions
- Meshy Auto-Rig API is available via BYOK (same key as generate). Prefer GLB with skeleton; VRM if Meshy returns it.
- SkinTokens not wired in this ticket (contract already allows later).
- Credit estimate may stay approximate; live balance still via refresh.

## Security Coverage
- B-01/B-04: Edge-only Meshy key; owner-scoped storage paths; SSRF-safe download helpers reused.
- B-10/P-06: N/A (no new worker/outbox).
- F-01/F-03: UI status strings only; no new free-text sinks.
- Out of scope: B-07–B-09 permission admin.

## Composition Gate
- Producer: Meshy Auto-Rig task → Edge materialize → `modelUrl`.
- Consumer: AvatarCanvas load → `#6` analysis.
- One SoT for capabilities: `#6` only; provider success → `pending`.
- N-actors: owner_user_id on job; no cross-tenant URLs.
- Invalid: failed auto-rig fails closed (failed job), no silent static-as-ready.
